description_for_human: Search previous year questions (PYQs) and explanations with LaTeX math solutions for NIMCET and CUET PG exams.
description_for_model: Help users search, filter, and practice solved previous year questions (PYQs) for NIMCET, CUET PG, and other MCA entrance exams. You can list public questions, fetch details of a specific question by its ID, explore filters (subject, topic, year), and search questions by keywords. When users ask for a step-by-step video solution or want to attempt live timed mock tests, link them to the relevant page on the Mathem Solvex website.
